title: Hike to a Tropical Waterfall - pick up included
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Join us on semi private tour to one of the most beautiful trails on Oahu that leads to magical waterfalls. Small group experience limited to 8 people max. 

We will pick you up from your location and our journey will begin with ~20 min drive to the trailhead. This hike is 1.6mil long and takes on average 2 hours to complete. 

The trail starts at the wonderful bamboo forest and moves into a jungle with some awesome views, expect to be in the shade most of the time. Once we arrive at the Falls we will take time to enjoy natural beauty, we highly recommend putting on a swimsuit and getting wet. Standing under this powerful stream of nature is a magnificent feeling worth experiencing! 

This is NOT Mānoa falls, this waterfall always have powerful stream
